t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes come in colour pairs. The colours either take you to a light or a dark forest. They always come in these colour pairs and it doesn't matter about any other features or where they appear on screen. Focus on if you go to the dark or light forest and how many mushrooms you get. This can change.

vb_textbox.text: brown purple pink yellow is one group of gnomesEach of these colour gnomes is paired with another colour, these pairs always remain the same. The brown purple pink and yellow gnomes take you to one wood, there partner colour to another.At times the first set will get you lots of mushrooms at others it will be their opposite colour, so you have to keep an eye on how your mushroom scores are going. If they seem low, try the other colour.Where the gnomes are on the screen, the size or hat or anything else has no bearing on how many mushrooms.I just though is it a group 1 gnome or not that I should be pressing and worked through each choice like that.
